description: This file contains C++ source code implementing classes and functions related to Xcode project object representations, including PBX objects, build phases, targets, and project configurations.

classes.name: PBXObject
classes.description: Base class for all PBX objects representing elements of an Xcode project.

classes.name: PBXTarget
classes.description: Represents a build target in an Xcode project, including dependencies and build phases.

classes.name: PBXProject
classes.description: Represents an entire Xcode project, including targets, configurations, and main group.

classes.name: PBXBuildPhase
classes.description: Abstract class for build phases, managing build files.

classes.name: XCConfigurationList
classes.description: Holds a list of build configurations for a target or project.

classes.name: XCBuildConfiguration
classes.description: Represents a single build configuration with settings.

classes.name: PBXFileReference
classes.description: Represents a file or resource reference in the project.

classes.name: PBXGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of files or other groups, forming the project hierarchy.

classes.name: PBXNativeTarget
classes.description: Represents a native build target with associated build phases and dependencies.

classes.name: PBXAggregateTarget
classes.description: Represents an aggregate target, a collection of build targets.

classes.name: PBXShellScriptBuildPhase
classes.description: Build phase for executing shell scripts.

classes.name: PBXBuildFile
classes.description: Represents a file to be built or linked in a build phase.

classes.name: PBXContainerItemProxy
classes.description: Proxy object linking targets and projects.

methods.name: Reference
methods.description: Returns the reference string for the object, including comment if available.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to traverse the object hierarchy.

methods.name: AddBuildFile
methods.description: Adds a build file to a build phase.

methods.name: AddSourceFile
methods.description: Adds a source file reference to the main group and optionally to a target.

methods.name: CreateChild
methods.description: Creates and adds a child PBX object to a group.
